name: lefthook-script-named-by-its-key
description: A lefthook file names a script by a key of a hook's scripts mapping and by a job's script value, and lefthook runs it from its source_dir below a directory named after the hook, with its runner. Each such script is a root as the path of the command lefthook runs, so neither file is reported, though no value of the file writes its path, while a file nothing names is reported at the class certain.
